body:
The sky was a dusky blue as I watched the stray cats gather in the shadows of the old warehouse. Their eyes flickered from corner to corner, seeking out the safety they knew lay beneath my feet. My heart swelled with protection, knowing these creatures had lost their homes and now huddled under my watchful gaze.

I stepped closer, my hand instinctively reaching out to stroke one of the heads. "It's okay," I whispered, feeling a surge of calm. "Stay where you are."
